test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

You cannot walk __throughout deserts by__. bare feet or they'll get burned.
solution:
The correct answer is: **through deserts on**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence contains an error in the preposition used after "throughout deserts."
